ja232:1.1: Having had a sole thought of welfare
ja232:1.2: the fool, who is not a guide,
ja232:1.3: Is surely not worthy to join up, dear lady, with the hunchbacked dwarf.
ja232:2.1: Thinking this was a bull of a man,
ja232:2.3: This same shrunken person lies down
ja232:2.4: like a lute with a broken string.
